A '''tech-suit''' was a suit of clothing found on [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Spilferithimus-narlamos]] wore a [[Human/Legends|Human]]-sized [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmet]] and tech-suit to disguise himself from [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]].<ref name="KOTOR">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>
